seed: <CUSTODIAN: private random string, 32 to 256 characters, never reused>

attestation.reviewer: <CUSTODIAN: name or handle of the person who reviewed every label>
attestation.reviewedAt: <CUSTODIAN: UTC time of the review, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ>

cases.id: <CUSTODIAN: unique id, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens>
cases.family: <CUSTODIAN: pii:global:network-address | pii:global:email | pii:global:payment-card | pii:global:iban | pii:us:ssn | pii:global:phone>
cases.selector: <CUSTODIAN: pii:family:<family without the pii: prefix> | pii:global (global families only) | pii:us>
cases.axis: <CUSTODIAN: short tag for the evidence class, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens>
cases.twinOf: <CUSTODIAN: id of the one-property twin in the same family and view, or null>

candidate.start: <CUSTODIAN: UTF-8 byte offset where the value starts>
candidate.end: <CUSTODIAN: UTF-8 byte offset where the value ends>
